title: The 5+ scorecard components
mechanism: The combined predictor score is a weighted blend of analog-cohort-derived components (return-potential, multibagger-odds, downside-safety) plus folded signals (crowded_window, wipeout-safety); liquidity/quality/tradeable-upside are display-only at weight 0.
status_rollup: in_score: return_potential, multibagger_odds, downside_safety; display_only (weight 0): tradeable_upside, liquidity, quality

title: SEBI anchor lock-in (30d/90d) supply-wave dips
mechanism: Field&Hanka US lockup-expiry effect applied to SEBI anchor lock-in (50% @30d + 50% @90d post-2022-04): an abnormal alpha dip proportional to anchor share, buyable as a knowable calendar.
status_rollup: rejected (FALSIFIED - placebo inverted; no Indian replication)

title: Wallet-competition clusters (overlapping subscription windows)
mechanism: A finite retail wallet shared across concurrently-open books: GMP-rank effects, tone-setting, fatigue, and a retail congestion tax. The congestion tax is the only piece that survived (as the in-score crowded_window).
status_rollup: in_score via crowded_window (congestion tax mechanism, F2d); rejected: F2a neglected-member, F2b tone-setting, F2c ordinal fatigue

title: Junk x bull -> rentable 1-month bounce (conditional take-profit)
mechanism: Low-quality x bull listing regime -> reliable 1-month MFE (sell-into-strength works there), the same junk in bear dies on arrival; re-opens the rejected unconditional take-profit as a conditional rule.
status_rollup: rejected (FALSIFIED twice: placebo + PIT re-test; bull-gate flips across cohorts)

title: Bear-window stop-loss
mechanism: Test whether the rejected 'stops lose to buy-and-hold' was a bull-era artifact by applying stops ONLY in bear-during-window cohorts (2008/2011/2022).
status_rollup: rejected (stops lose even in bear windows; no-stop truth now unconditional and conditional)

title: Behavioral reference-point path dynamics
mechanism: Reference levels (issue price, listing-day high, round numbers) as psychological magnets/ceilings; only F5e capitulation (never reclaimed issue by ~90d -> elevated wipeout) survived.
status_rollup: validated display: F5e capitulation; rejected: F5a issue magnet, F5b LDH breakout, F5c volume reclaim, F5d ordering, F5f round numbers

title: Derivatives of GMP (raw level is in-score)
mechanism: Second-order GMP signals: surprise residual, retail interaction, regime sign-flip, and the T+3 transmission natural experiment.
status_rollup: watchlist: F6a GMP-surprise (weak lean); rejected: F6b interaction, F6c regime, F6d T+3

title: Sequential learning / cold-tape vs hot-chase
mechanism: The prior cohort's realized listing pops drive next-cohort retail demand AND forward alpha; IPOs braving a cold streak are demand-validated and outperform the hot-chase.
status_rollup: validated display (4/4 cells + OOS-directional); fold test failed (1/5) -> not in score

title: Day-1 buying from the denied allotment lottery
mechanism: Day-1 buying proportional to how much the allotment lottery denied (sub-1 = unfilled multiple), incremental to raw subscription.
status_rollup: rejected (inverted - undersubscribed are simply worse; junk dominates)

title: Nth same-sector IPO progressively worse
mechanism: Each successive same-sector IPO within 12 months should perform progressively worse as the theme tires.
status_rollup: rejected (IC -0.012; no decay, slightly opposite)

title: Bonus/split within year 1 = euphoria top
mechanism: A bonus/split with ex-date 30-365d after listing follows a huge run-up and marks the euphoric TOP (an exit tell), not a healthy company.
status_rollup: validated-thin display (n=31 exit flag); revisit as N grows

title: Outcome-based climate index (vs count-based heat)
mechanism: A size-weighted realized retail-P&L climate gauge to refine or replace the count-based crowded_window heat signal.
status_rollup: rejected (size-weighting worse than simple median-pop climate)

title: Second-tier calendar, regime, scheduling and path tests
mechanism: Lower-priority structural ideas: day-180 unlock, first-week x regime, transition fragility, recovery by phase, banker collision, ASBA echo, day-1 flipping, SME circuit-cage.
status_rollup: all rejected: T2a, T2b, T2c, T2e, T2g, T2h, T2i, T2j

title: Market-context point-in-time signals
mechanism: Pre-listing macro/market-context features tested vs 1y alpha across the 4 regime cells; only crowded IPO heat (count-based) survived.
status_rollup: in_score: ctx_ipo_heat_90d (= crowded_window); rejected: ctx_nifty_mom_3m, ctx_heat_pop_90d, ctx_sector_heat_180d, macro commodities

title: A separate short-game model / flip-the-hot edge
mechanism: Whether a demand-percentile SHORT score or a flip-the-hot-pops rule can capture a tradable short-horizon edge.
status_rollup: rejected: SHORT score (no edge; LONG score is the better short-horizon predictor), hot-pop-then-fade (opposite holds - strength persists)

title: 48-hypothesis sweep across issue structure / demand / path / fundamentals
mechanism: 4 subagents generated 48 hypotheses (deduped to ~34 testable features), each tested by rank-IC + tercile alpha_1y spread across the 4 regime cells. No new PRE-IPO signal cleared the robustness bar.
status_rollup: validated conditioning (post-listing): path_ratio_1m; watchlist: pe_vs_sector, qib_retail_ratio; ~30 rejected (band_position, anchor_ratio, fixed_price, promoter_dilution_pp, size_z, min_investment, all_ofs, banker_prior_alpha, nii_froth, gmp_sub_disagree, gmp_z, undersubscribed, demand_per_size, breadth_hot_count, qib_cold_retail_hot, sales_accel_spike, cf_conversion, borrow_ramp, opm_trend, sales_vs_asset_growth, fresh_dilution, profitable_stagnant, objects_debt_repay, lday_close_position, lday_green, lday_giveback, volatility_early, circuit_lock, days_to_peak, turnover_to_size)

title: Pre-listing wipeout red flags
mechanism: Which pre-listing features flag wipeout/dead-money risk: tiny pre-IPO sales and loss-making at IPO survived (additive count); micro-mcap / low-promoter / high-GMP / high-debt were rejected (reverse-causation or wrong sign).
status_rollup: in_score: wipeout_safety (folded); validated badge: tiny-sales + loss-making (+ obscure-banker); rejected: micro mcap, low promoter, high GMP, high debt

title: Two-factor interactions (super-additive tests)
mechanism: Whether pairs of factors are super-additive (better/worse together than apart); only low-debt x high-ROE (clean compounder) survived cross-regime.
status_rollup: validated (separate layer, not scored): low-debt x high-ROE; rejected: any risk pair, tiny-sales x loss-making (single-regime)

title: The original Tier-1 directional predicates
mechanism: The first-pass directional claims subjected to cross-regime validation: pop-fade held (sign), OFS-skin and profitable-at-IPO flipped sign across regimes.
status_rollup: validated: pred_pop_fade (within-vintage weak); rejected (sign flips): pred_ofs_skin, pred_profitable_ipo

title: Trading strategies vs do-nothing (buy-and-hold)
mechanism: Backtested strategies for the secondary buyer / allottee: buy-and-hold, filters, flip, take-profit ladders, stop-losses, averaging down, partial exit. Core truth: no exit rule beats buy-and-hold cross-regime.
status_rollup: all rejected as edges: secondary_hold, secondary_filtered, avoid_hot, flip_listing, take_profit_ladder, stop_loss, average_down, partial_exit (partial_exit kept display-only as a median-vs-mean tradeoff)

title: Fallen-angel recovery, accrual flag, subscription saturation
mechanism: Descriptive predicates outside the score: fallen-angel recovery (unpredictable), accrual/cash-flow flag (strong but not cross-regime-validated), subscription saturation (boom-only).
status_rollup: rejected (validated-null): n13_fallen_angel; watchlist: n8_accrual; parked (single-regime): n2_subscription
